<div class="review-text">
A horrible, technophobic, and bland story written seemingly by somebody losing their grip on reality. Dandelion wine presents a horrible, conservative view of life in the United States which is grossly unrepresentative of the issues it tries to address. It left me with an awful, sickening feeling in my stomach after reading this traditionalist and regressive book. Avoid at all costs.
